title: Amendments gate cannot see epic notes applied before the records existed
body:
The 8em note on epic 43y was applied by an older binary, so no amendment record exists for it and gateCloseoutOnAmendments cannot hold 43y's close-out on it; coverage for pre-existing worker-authored notes is prompt-side only (the close-out retro names them unconfirmed from the epic's notes). Worth a tick of its own if the operator wants pre-existing notes mechanically held: derive them from the epic's notes and the run's absorption/decision records, or give the operator a way to file a confirmation for a note applied before this change.
evidence: .tick/issues/43y.json notes 2026-10-05 18:25; internal/reconcile/closeout_body.go (the amendments section's absence line names the limit)
